features.quote: Decide whether the model is told it can give up, and make this an explicit logged condition
features.justification_quote: "Permission to quit" vs "no exit" is itself an interesting variable

features.quote: You are deliberately putting models into engineered failure loops and measuring something you're framing as distress
features.justification_quote: it's inconsistent to also assume there's definitely nothing it's like to be in the loop; the honest position is uncertainty

features.quote: the cheap hedge is to cap run length and not pile on gratuitously
features.justification_quote: the welfare hedge and the validity concern point the same way — keep runs short
